market_notes.market: The widest stretch readings this book has recorded
market_notes.note: Six of eleven cryptos carry stretch penalties and the score-versus-core gaps are the largest yet: XRP 45 against core 75, ADA 35 against 65, and BTC, DOGE, LTC and AVAX all 45 against 65. Five RSI-above-70 crossings alerted in one session - BTC 72.6, XRP 70.1, DOGE 72.2, ADA 72.8 - with LTC at 78.8 and AVAX at 79.8 already above. ADA's STRONG BUY -> BUY came through correctly tagged 'stretch penalty applied, trend/momentum unchanged', exactly the case core_score was built for. market_notes.market: What the stretch does and does not mean
market_notes.note: The engine is flagging extension, not weakness - every stretched name still has core 65 or better. Coverage frames it usefully: readings this stretched do not predict a top, but they do mean the easy part of the move has happened. Nothing follows for the two open positions, since both stops trail mechanically and neither moved. What it does change is the bar on any NEW entry - the satellite rule already requires RSI below 70 at selection, and on today's board that excludes six of the eleven.
